facts.fact: The Reserve Bank of Malawi's director of national payment systems told a 25 November 2026 conference that the central bank's upgraded Malawi Interbank Transfer and Settlement System (MITASS) went live on 9 November 2026.

systems.country_label: Malawi Interbank Transfer and Settlement System

facts.fact: The Reserve Bank of Malawi advised customers whose complaints about digital financial services stay unresolved by their providers to report them to the central bank's consumer protection office.

facts.fact: The Reserve Bank of Malawi's payments director said on 25 November 2026 that Malawi has more than 22.8 million registered mobile money wallets, of which over 13 million are active.
